title: Every AI Model Does This Billions of Times a Day
description:
Every AI model gets trained once. Everything anyone does with it after that is inference: the frozen weights running against brand new input, on every single request. Training makes the headlines. Inference is the bill, the latency, and the part you actually operate.

I break down what one request actually does. Tokens, prefill, the KV cache, decode, and the two numbers you feel: time to first token and time per output token. Then the four levers that make it fast and cheap, the inference engines that run it, and when self-hosted pays off over hosted.

Then what inference looks like in my own AI pipeline, self-hosted and hosted. And the 2026 twist: reasoning models, where the cost of a request depends on how hard the model thinks.

#AI #AIEngineering #inference #LLM #MachineLearning
